content:
Hi /lgbt/,

I just want to hold this boy's hand. I mean, even if it wasn't him specifically, I just wanna hold a boy's hand in the hallway and be lined up against the walls of public rejection, ostracized for being who I am. Why does anyone care? Why do they hate us for loving? That's so ironic, bros. It feels weird to hear people casually insulting us as if we didn't even exist right next to them. Any chance of a social life I had before would be obliterated by coming out of this cage. I just like to be a cute girly boy, what's wrong with that?

Why even live?
